name: Dispatch
description: A LiquidJS (Tier-2 / templated) demonstrator: a magazine-style front page whose entry grid is authored with Liquid loops, conditionals, and filters — the logic the fixed-component declarative tier can't express — while reusing Tovu's shared header/footer components via the {% render_block %} seam. Proves ADR-020's templated tier end-to-end. Executes no theme JavaScript.
